title: This Free App Turns AI Into a Full Office
description:
Comment "OFFICE" and I'll DM you the download + setup steps.

Someone built a free open source app that turns Claude Code into an entire office of AI agents:

1. It's called Munder Difflin. MIT licensed source code, past 5,000 stars on GitHub
2. Every agent is a real terminal session underneath, shown as a character at a desk on a 2D office floor
3. They message each other, and they share one memory layer, so nothing gets re-explained
4. You don't manage them. You talk to Michael, a clone of you that routes the work and escalates only when it needs you
5. It wraps 12 agent CLIs: Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, Grok, Kimi, Gemini CLI, Qwen, OpenCode, Crush, pi.dev, Copilot CLI and Cursor
6. Runs local on macOS, Windows and Linux
7. It's free for you as an individual. You still need your own Claude, OpenAI or Copilot plan (or your own API keys) to power the agents

It's an early prototype, so treat it like one. But the floor is genuinely fun to watch.

Comment "OFFICE" and I'll DM you the repo + how to get it running.

#claudecode #aiagents #vibecoding #opensource #aitools
